in_marathi.name: Gangaadatt
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gangaadatt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gangaadatt is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ganga' meaning 'river' and 'datt' meaning 'given'. This name is a reference to the Hindu mythology where the Goddess Ganga is believed to have given life to the king Sahasrarjuna by descending from the heavens as a river.
